integrity.reason: No new application writes/storage; unchanged strict create schema, idempotency and authority implementation. Fresh database races are outside this delta, not claimed.

maintainability.reason: Small native details/labelled textarea/button and existing tokens, no new dependencies. Duplicated template documentation has future drift risk only.

operations.reason: Production verifier binding equals UAT, origins/Hyperdrive/R2 isolated, no test flags or lifecycle changes. Clean candidate CI/dry-run/deployment/provider proof are separate later gates.
